actions.body:
Autonomous agents often rely on local continuity assumptions that can fail under dynamic adversarial conditions. By combining metric temporal logic with probabilistic virtual scenario generators, complex decision systems can systematically expose and evaluate foundational vulnerabilities. [source-69e14bf08060491d] Furthermore, rigorous risk-sensitive modeling frameworks provide a robust quantitative basis for tracking these vulnerabilities over time. [source-a499e83cfad44bf6]

Summary: Autonomous systems need formal tools like metric temporal logic to test and correct their core assumptions rather than relying solely on default local continuity.
actions.lede: Exploring how autonomous systems can formally test and falsify their own epistemic axioms using metric temporal logic.
